defaultPrompt: Proofread this Luxembourgish text without changing its meaning.
Draft a professional email in Luxembourgish.
Explain this Luxembourgish spelling and cite the relevant rule.
interface.longDescription: Write, translate and improve Luxembourgish emails and documents. LëtzTools reviews spelling in context, checks word usage and explains orthography with citations. With your permission, live spelling and dictionary checks send eligible words or queries to LOD. LëtzTools is an independent project.

name: letz-tools
description: Luxembourgish writing help with spellchecker.lu, LOD and the official orthography guide, without a hosted backend.
